dedupe_keys.name: ghs built up grid from sentinel 1 2016 r2018a

description: The European Commission Joint Research Centre provides a global built-up presence grid derived from Sentinel-1 radar acquisitions centred on 2016. Its R2018A product is a binary 20 m classification in GeoTIFF tiles with a VRT index, served through JRC's named dataset page. The page allows anonymous access free of charge and applies the European Commission reuse licence notice with source acknowledgement. Its metadata gives a wider acquisition interval from December 2015 to December 2017, so the product should not be interpreted as a precise annual construction census. Infrastructure exposure models can use the historical settlement footprint as a spatial screen before joining roads, buildings or population layers. It does not provide asset types, condition or occupancy, and JRC marks the release obsolete. The public page establishes this exact DOI and rights despite an older generic browser link that could not identify the layer. It complements the Landsat R2018A draft and the catalogue's current GHSL record; no raster was downloaded.
